queries.description: Select AVG aggregation for a BIG_DECIMAL column, TODO:(No need to cast in LogicalProject)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT AVG(a.col4) as avg FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= (SELECT AVG(a.col4) FROM a)

queries.description: Select AVG aggregation for a BIG_DECIMAL column, TODO:(No need to cast in LogicalProject)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT AVG(a.col4) as avg FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select many aggregations for a BIG_DECIMAL column, TODO:(No need to cast in LogicalProject)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT AVG(a.col4) as avg, SUM(a.col4) as sum, MAX(a.col4) as max FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select aggregates with filters and select alias
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT AVG(a.col3) as avg, COUNT(*) as count FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select aggregates
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(a.col3), COUNT(a.col1) FROM a

queries.description: Select aggregates with filters
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(a.col3), COUNT(*) FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'a'

queries.description: Select aggregates with filters and select alias
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(a.col3) as sum, COUNT(*) as count FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select aggregates with filters and select alias. The group by aggregate hint should be a no-op.
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ AVG(a.col3) as avg, COUNT(*) as count FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select aggregates with filters and select alias. The group by aggregate hint should be a no-op.
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ SUM(a.col3) as sum, COUNT(*) as count FROM a WHERE a.col3 >= 0 AND a.col2 = 'pink floyd'

queries.description: Select aggregates with literals on top of a union
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR with teamOne as (select /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ col2, percentile(col3, 50) as sum_of_runs from a group by col2), teamTwo as (select /*+ aggOptions(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ col2, percentile(col3, 50) as sum_of_runs from a group by col2), all as (select col2, sum_of_runs from teamOne union all select col2, sum_of_runs from teamTwo) select /*+ aggOption(is_skip_leaf_stage_group_by='true') */ col2, percentile(sum_of_runs, 50) from all group by col2

queries.description: FIRST_WITH_TIME and LAST_WITH_TIME without a data type infer it from the data argument
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT FIRST_WITH_TIME(a.col1, a.ts), LAST_WITH_TIME(a.ts_timestamp, a.ts), FIRST_WITH_TIME(a.col5, a.ts), LAST_WITH_TIME(a.col1, a.ts) FROM a
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{}], agg#0=[FIRSTWITHTIME($0, $0, _UTF-8'STRING')], agg#1=[LASTWITHTIME($1, $1, _UTF-8'TIMESTAMP')], agg#2=[FIRSTWITHTIME($2, $2, _UTF-8'BOOLEAN')], agg#3=[LASTWITHTIME($3, $3, _UTF-8'STRING')], aggType=[FINAL])

PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{}], agg#0=[FIRSTWITHTIME($0, $1, _UTF-8'STRING')], agg#1=[LASTWITHTIME($2, $1, _UTF-8'TIMESTAMP')], agg#2=[FIRSTWITHTIME($3, $1, _UTF-8'BOOLEAN')], agg#3=[LASTWITHTIME($0, $1, _UTF-8'STRING')], aggType=[LEAF])

queries.description: Inferred data type argument next to another literal argument in a grouped aggregate
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT a.col2, FIRST_WITH_TIME(a.col3 + 1, a.ts), PERCENTILE(a.col3, 50) FROM a GROUP BY a.col2

queries.description: FIRST_WITH_TIME and LAST_WITH_TIME without a data type infer BIG_DECIMAL and BYTES
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT FIRST_WITH_TIME(a.col4, a.ts), LAST_WITH_TIME(hexToBytes(a.col1), a.ts) FROM a

queries.description: ARRAY_AGG without a data type infers it from the expression as the second argument
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_AGG(a.col1), ARRAY_AGG(a.col3, true), ARRAY_AGG(a.col4), ARRAY_AGG(a.ts_timestamp, true), ARRAY_AGG(a.col5), ARRAY_AGG(a.col7 + 1) FROM a
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{}], agg#0=[ARRAYAGG($0, _UTF-8'STRING')], agg#1=[ARRAYAGG($1, _UTF-8'INT', true)], agg#2=[ARRAYAGG($2, _UTF-8'BIG_DECIMAL')], agg#3=[ARRAYAGG($3, _UTF-8'TIMESTAMP', true)], agg#4=[ARRAYAGG($4, _UTF-8'BOOLEAN')], agg#5=[ARRAYAGG($5, _UTF-8'LONG')], aggType=[FINAL])

PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{}], agg#0=[ARRAYAGG($0, _UTF-8'STRING')], agg#1=[ARRAYAGG($1, _UTF-8'INT', true)], agg#2=[ARRAYAGG($3, _UTF-8'BIG_DECIMAL')], agg#3=[ARRAYAGG($4, _UTF-8'TIMESTAMP', true)], agg#4=[ARRAYAGG($5, _UTF-8'BOOLEAN')], agg#5=[ARRAYAGG($6, _UTF-8'LONG')], aggType=[LEAF])

queries.description: ARRAY_AGG without a data type next to the explicit forms in a grouped aggregate
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT a.col2, ARRAY_AGG(a.col3, true), ARRAY_AGG(a.col3, 'LONG', true), ARRAY_AGG(a.col1, 'STRING') FROM a GROUP BY a.col2
output: PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[ARRAYAGG($1, _UTF-8'INT', true)], agg#1=[ARRAYAGG($2, _UTF-8'LONG', true)], agg#2=[ARRAYAGG($3, _UTF-8'STRING')], aggType=[FINAL])
PinotLogicalAggregate(group=[{0}], agg#0=[ARRAYAGG($1, _UTF-8'INT', true)], agg#1=[ARRAYAGG($1, _UTF-8'LONG', true)], agg#2=[ARRAYAGG($4, _UTF-8'STRING')], aggType=[LEAF])

queries.description: ARRAY_AGG without a data type uses the element type of a multi-value column
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_AGG(e.mcol1), ARRAY_AGG(e.mcol2, true) FROM e

queries.description: ARRAY_AGG without a data type rejects an unsupported expression type
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT ARRAY_AGG(CAST(a.col1 AS DATE), true) FROM a

queries.description: MIN on STRING column rewritten to MINSTRING
queries.sql: SET autoRewriteAggregationType=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT MIN(a.col1) FROM a

queries.description: MIN on INT column not rewritten
queries.sql: SET autoRewriteAggregationType=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT MIN(a.col3) FROM a

queries.description: MAX on STRING column rewritten to MAXSTRING
queries.sql: SET autoRewriteAggregationType=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT MAX(a.col2) FROM a

queries.description: MAX on INT column not rewritten
queries.sql: SET autoRewriteAggregationType=true; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT MAX(a.col3) FROM a

queries.description: SUM on MV LONG column plans natively as SUM (no broker rewrite)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT SUM(mcol2) FROM e

queries.description: AVG on MV LONG column plans natively as AVG (no broker rewrite)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT AVG(mcol2) FROM e

queries.description: MIN/MAX on MV LONG column plan natively (no broker rewrite)
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT MIN(mcol2), MAX(mcol2) FROM e
